comment: The models the benchmark runs. Add or remove a block, or set enabled to false to keep a model's history without running it. `tier` is which Chief tier the model competes in (it decides the context window and cache ceiling the engine starts with). Weights are downloaded once into bench/.models (gitignored) and their SHA-256 is written into every run's env.json, so a changed file is visible. `revision` should be a commit hash once a model is chosen; `main` is for trying one out.

models.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
models.notes: Chief's current standard-tier model (weights.rs STANDARD), run on the light profile to compare on the 8 GB machine.

models.name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
models.notes: Fast fallback. Not pinned to a revision yet.

models.name: Qwen3 4B Instruct 2507
models.notes: Best tool calls and stand-up content in the 2 Oct run, but looped on repeated pull requests. Not pinned to a revision yet.
